description: List message templates on an official WhatsApp Business API session (provider 'meta'). On the official API you can only send free-form messages to someone who messaged you in the last 24 hours; outside that window only an approved template is delivered. Use a template's name + language with neuron_send_whatsapp / neuron_compose_message / neuron_create_broadcast (messageType 'template').

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the session (must be an official API session)

name: neuron_list_whatsapp_templates
title: List WhatsApp Templates
